versions.changelog:
workbuddy-skill-visibility v1.0.1

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- Set disable-model-invocation to false in SKILL.md for broader model support.
- No changes to the main logic or user-facing features.

Initial release of workbuddy-skill-visibility.

- Makes WorkBuddy built-in skills visible in the "Installed Skills" list via a safe copy (replica) approach, supporting one-step restore.
- Provides commands for listing, syncing, status check, restoring, and verifying built-in skills and their replicas.
- Includes robust path and environment detection—no hardcoded directories—and avoids risky actions without user consent.
- Offers optional (not recommended) frontend bundle patching for advanced users, with strong safety checks.
- Ensures clear diagnostics, explicit outputs, and dry-run options before any file changes.
- No third-party dependencies; pure Python standard library.
